top_violation_types.title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current health inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The ground is splitting open and causing a tripping hazard at the entrance to the playground.       Photos taken

top_violation_types.title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Thermometer, preferably non-glass (26 TAC §746.4003(a)(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The first aid kit was missing a thermometer.

top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.

top_violation_types.title: Discipline - Teaches Acceptable Behavior and Self-control (26 TAC §746.2803(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information obtained, it was determined the operations discipline methods does not teach acceptable behavior and self-control.

top_violation_types.title: Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly (26 TAC §746.3407(10))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection, certain areas of the center exhibited low temperatures. Two thermostats indicated readings of 60 degrees and 64 degrees, while the external temperature was recorded at below 40 degrees.

top_violation_types.title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The carbon monoxide detector is not being tested monthly.

top_violation_types.title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Documentation showing children were signed into care was not available upon request.
